title: FIMS Blog
description: >
  **Category Definitions**
  <br>
  <i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span class="visually-hidden">Category icon: </span><strong>deep-dive</strong>: learning about complex stock assessment concepts, academic exercises, and statistical best practices <br>
  <i class="fa-solid fa-newspaper" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span class="visually-hidden">Category icon: </span><strong>fims-weekly</strong>: FIMS weekly newsletter posts <br>
  <i class="fa-solid fa-graduation-cap" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span class="visually-hidden">Category icon: </span><strong>learn</strong>: learning about packages within FIMS, geared toward beginner and intermediate users <br>
  <i class="fa-solid fa-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span class="visually-hidden">Category icon: </span><strong>other</strong>: posts that do not fit the other categories <br>
  <br>

  **Filtering**
  <br>
  Filter blog posts by major category using the categories panel. You can also filter by selecting a category listed on an individual post below. To clear the filter, select "Categories" in the navigation panel.
  <br>
listing:
  contents:
    - "*.qmd"
    - "!fims-weekly-template.qmd"
    - "!blog_template.qmd"
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  feed: true
  categories: true
  sort-ui: true
  filter-ui: true
  fields: [title, subtitle, date, author, categories]
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
comments: false
header-includes: >
  <script src="assets/scripts.js" defer></script>
---
